patches.name: AMOLED dark theme
patches.description: Makes Strava dark mode true-black for OLED screens: the dark surface colors (#141413 / #21211f / #43423f) are remapped to a black ladder. Light mode is untouched.

patches.name: Allow standalone install (split-less APK)
patches.description: Removes Pdb's base-APK split requirement (requiredSplitTypes=base__abi,base__density) so the single patched APK installs. Required when patching the App Bundle's base APK.

patches.name: Bypass PairIP
patches.description: Disables adidas Running's PairIP licence/VM verification, restores the real Application class and bakes the VM's runtime strings (captured from the original app's heap) so Firebase etc. initialize cleanly. NOTE: adidas runs the full PairIP VM whose startup program is the tamper check — the patched app boots past the licence gate but the VM-virtualized init methods cannot be restored without native reverse engineering, so the app may crash after launch. See docs/adidas.md.

patches.name: Bypass PairIP
patches.description: Disables Glassdoor's PairIP integrity/licence verification (full VM + native check), restores the real Application class, removes the licence activity, and restores the runtime strings the VM would have provided.

patches.name: Bypass PairIP
patches.description: Disables Shima+'s PairIP licence/trial verification, restores the real Application class and removes the licence activity.

patches.name: Bypass PairIP license check
patches.description: Disables Material Capsule's PairIP / Play licence verification so the app runs after Morphe re-signs it. Restores the real Application class (com.pryshedko.mtisland.App).

patches.name: Bypass PairIP license check
patches.description: Disables Pdb's PairIP / Play licence verification so the app runs after Morphe re-signs it. Restores the real Application class (pdb.app.App).

patches.name: Chat button on profiles
patches.description: Adds a 'Chat' entry to the profile screen's ⋯ menu: opens your conversation with that user when one exists, otherwise their profile (channels are server-created — no fake channel making).

patches.name: Custom app name
patches.description: Renames the launcher label (Settings > Apps, home screen) to the value of the stravaAppName option. Leave the option empty to keep the original name.

options.title: Custom launcher name
options.description: The app name shown in the launcher and app drawer. Empty = keep "Strava".

patches.name: Disable AppCenter telemetry
patches.description: No-ops Microsoft AppCenter's SDK bootstrap (configureAndStartServices / startServices) so the bundled telemetry/crash SDK never initialises.

patches.name: Disable AppsFlyer
patches.description: No-ops AppsFlyer's start() and logEvent() entry points, so no install attribution or analytics events are sent.

patches.name: Disable AppsFlyer
patches.description: No-ops AppsFlyer's start() and logEvent() entry points, so no install attribution or analytics events are sent.

patches.name: Disable AppsFlyer
patches.description: Neutralizes AppsFlyer attribution/telemetry: the SDK is never initialized or started, and the JS bridge reports success as usual.

patches.name: Disable CleverTap
patches.description: Stops CleverTap session/activity tracking and push-click attribution. Push notifications themselves keep working.

patches.name: Disable Firebase Performance + installer check
patches.description: Makes Firebase Performance's connection wrapper a pass-through (no perf telemetry) and reports installs as Play-installed regardless of the actual installer.

patches.name: Disable PairIP license check
patches.description: Disables PairIP license verification, VM checks, and repeated background checks.

patches.name: Disable SSL pinning
patches.description: Unpins the react-native-ssl-pinning OkHttp client so HTTPS traffic can be intercepted, and trusts user-installed CAs (targetSdk 35). Normal TLS validation stays intact.

patches.name: Disable SSL pinning
patches.description: Removes certificate pinning at both layers (OkHttp pin comparison and the platform network-security-config pin-set) and trusts user-installed CAs, so HTTPS traffic can be inspected with a MITM proxy. Normal TLS validation stays intact.

patches.name: Disable ad SDK
patches.description: No-ops the Google Mobile Ads initialisation so the ad SDK never starts.

patches.name: Disable security checks
patches.description: Stops Hutch from refusing to run on rooted, adb-enabled, developer-options or emulator devices. The device-integrity probes (jail-monkey + react-native-device-info) all answer "clean".

patches.name: Disable security checks
patches.description: Stops MyDialog from exiting itself on root/debug/emulator/adb detection and on Play Integrity failure. Signature verification is reported clean so patched builds pass.

patches.name: Disable telemetry (Sentry)
patches.description: Stops Proton VPN's Sentry crash/telemetry reporting and disables the large-metrics sampling multiplier. Accounts and VPN stay unaffected.

options.title: Disable telemetry
options.description: Disable Sentry reporting and Proton's large-metrics sampling.

patches.name: Disable tracker components

patches.name: Disable tracker components

patches.description: Disables Google Analytics for Firebase measurement and switches off Firebase Analytics / Advertising-ID data collection via the official opt-out flags.

patches.name: Enable dark mode

patches.name: Extra settings resources
patches.description: Registers the Extra Settings activity and applies the accent color.

options.title: Accent color
options.description: Replaces the Strava orange brand color family app-wide.

options.title: Export SuperUser debug console
options.description: Exports Strava's hidden SuperUserToolsActivity for adb access (feature-switch console, modular-UI tools, network settings). DEBUG-ONLY: any on-device app could then launch it. Off by default.

options.description: Removes the subscriber lock from the sticker/share overlay carousel (all client-rendered designs become selectable).

patches.name: Fix Firebase after re-signing
patches.description:
Fixes Firebase services (push notifications, Remote Config, Firebase Auth) that break after Morphe re-signs the app with a different certificate.

Apply with Original app certificate patch — no other config needed.

patches.name: Fix SIM identifier access
patches.description: Replaces the IMSI lookup with the public getSimOperator() call so the pre-login flow passes on Android 11+ where re-signed builds lost carrier privileges ('App Error: NO IMSI'). Falls back to Dialog's 41305 on SIM-less devices.

patches.name: Fix app icon
patches.description: Gives the default launcher icon a real foreground. The base APK ships an adaptive icon with a null foreground (the visible icon normally comes from a theme alias enabled at runtime).

patches.name: Fix launcher theme (PairIP VM)
patches.description: Points the launcher activity at the AppCompat @style/AppTheme instead of the splash theme, whose runtime theme-swap lives in the removed PairIP VM.

patches.name: Floating power button
patches.description: Adds a draggable quick-actions bubble to the main screen (profile IDs / receipts / pause toggles, copy your profile id, open Pdb Extras). Toggle: Pdb Extras → Quick → 'Show floating power button'.

patches.name: GmsCore support (MicroG)
patches.description:
Routes Google Play Services calls through MicroG instead of real GPS.

Works for: Google apps (YouTube, Maps, News, Photos) and third-party apps using classic Google Sign-In (Android 13 and below).

Does not work for: Android 14+ Credential Manager sign-in (most modern third-party apps), Play Integrity / SafetyNet checks, or apps with custom auth.

Requires MicroG RE installed. Apply with Original app certificate patch.

options.title: MicroG package name
options.description: Which MicroG / GmsCore app is installed on your device. Check your device's app list for "MicroG" or "GmsCore" if unsure — most users should leave this as the default.

options.title: Main activity class (optional)
options.description: The app's main Activity class name ending with a semicolon, e.g. /MainActivity; Used to inject the MicroG check at startup. Leave blank for auto-detection.

options.title: Custom package name (optional)
options.description: Rename the app to this package name. Leave blank to keep the original. Must be a valid package name (e.g. com.example.myapp).

patches.name: Inspect HTTPS traffic (adb reverse proxy)
patches.description: Routes RN network traffic through 127.0.0.1:8080 on the device (adb reverse tunnel to mitmproxy). Off by default; needs the tunnel and a trusted CA.

patches.name: Kill residual beacon traffic
patches.description: Silences the Facebook SDK's remaining phone-home: app-event uploads (/activities, /app) and the SDK config fetch (mobile_sdk_gk). The SDK class init stays alive (required by RN); only transmission dies.

patches.name: Mock Pro (client-side)
patches.description: Forces the client-side Pro entitlement (custom colors, card/anim controls, full-size player, app search, widgets, gestures). Material Capsule's premium is a local flag derived from a Play purchase query and stored AES-encrypted on-device — it is NOT server-re-validated, so the whole set opens. No purchase is fabricated; real purchases and restore still work.

patches.name: Mock Pro (client-side)
patches.description: Forces the app's client-side pro flag (isProUser → true) and the local ProStatus model: premium-badge UI, client-gated perks (unlimited rewinds, hide online, extra IRL slots) and pro-only screens open. Honestly: features the SERVER re-validates (premium Soul filters, coins, boosts, some AI limits) still refuse — that is a backend check no client patch can lift.

patches.name: No profile-visitor limit
patches.description: Lifts Pdb's client-side cap of 3 profile-visitor views per hour (the 'slow down' sheet). Toggle: Pdb Extras → Limits → 'No profile-visitor limit'. The bytecode ships always-on and is inert until the switch is on.

patches.name: Pdb Extras feature menu
patches.description: Adds a single Pdb Extras entry to the top of Pdb's Settings screen.

patches.name: Pdb Extras — resources
patches.description: Adds the Pdb Extras entry to the Settings screen and registers the extension components.

patches.name: Provide Original app certificate
patches.description: Automatically reads the signing certificate from the APK you are patching — no original app installed or file provided needed. Only fill the options below if you are patching an APK that was already re-signed (e.g. a previously patched build): in that case point to the original APK file, or enter the certificate manually.

options.title: Path to original APK (if uninstalled)
options.description: Full path to the original APK or .apks bundle. Example: /sdcard/Download/Waze.apks

options.title: Certificate SHA-1 (manual)
options.description: 40-char hex. Found on APKMirror under app signature info.

options.title: Certificate Base64 DER (manual)
options.description: Needed only for Signature spoof patch. Get it with: apksigner verify --print-certs original.apk

patches.name: Relocate runtime MMKV copy
patches.description: Copies the bundled MMKV library to a fresh file name so a stale copy from another ABI can never be loaded (fixes emulator crashes; no effect on a clean device).

patches.name: Remove AI assistant FAB (+ footer patch id)
patches.description: Removes the server-driven AI overlay FAB from every screen and surfaces the Morphe patch version on the side-menu footer ("ID ⚡<version>" next to the device id).

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: adidas Running ships no ad-serving SDK; this denies the advertising ID and the Privacy-Sandbox ad services and removes the install-referrer permission.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Fitbit ships no ad SDK or ad placement; this additionally disables any ad-SDK auto-init provider and removes the advertising-ID / ad-services / install-referrer permissions so no advertising ID is exposed.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Removes the advertising-ID, ad-services and install-referrer permissions (and disables any ad-SDK init provider). Glassdoor ships no third-party ad SDK.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Stops Google Mobile Ads from initialising (removes the AdMob app id) and strips the advertising-ID, ad-services and install-referrer permissions. Ad slots in the Flutter UI cannot be removed, but they no longer fill.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Material Capsule ships no ad SDK or ad placement; this additionally disables any ad-SDK auto-init provider and removes the advertising-ID / ad-services permissions so no advertising ID is exposed.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Nike Run Club ships no ad SDK or placement; this disables any ad-SDK auto-init provider and removes the advertising-ID / ad-services / referrer permissions so no advertising ID is exposed.

patches.name: Remove ads

patches.description: Microsoft Teams ships no ad SDK; this strips the advertising-ID, ad-services and install-referrer permissions and disables any ad-SDK init provider.

patches.name: Remove ads

patches.name: Remove server-change delay
patches.description: Sets the "change server" wait to zero and raises the attempt limit, so you can switch VPN servers freely.

options.title: Remove server-change delay
options.description: No wait and no attempt cap when changing VPN servers.

patches.name: Remove telemetry
patches.description: Strips Sentry, Embrace and Facebook analytics, disables Firebase analytics, and empties the advertising ID (push notifications keep working).

patches.name: Remove upsells & promos
patches.description: Removes Strava's subscription upsells and promos: server-driven modular upsells (matched by an upsell-shape predicate so new server types stay covered), subscription bottom-sheet upsells, and the dedicated upsell screens (Year in Sport 2026, Best Efforts Data Peek, Device Connect). Runtime toggles in Extra Settings; the Settings Subscriptions section is stripped.

patches.name: Show profile IDs on names
patches.description: Appends the numeric profile id (#1234567) after every profile name — Soul cards, chat headers, lists. Toggle: Pdb Extras → 'Show profile IDs on names'. The bytecode ships always-on and is inert until the switch is enabled, so the toggle works without rebuilding.

patches.name: Soul history
patches.description: Records every Soul profile you see or like into a local, on-device history (Pdb Extras / power button → 'Soul history'), so swipes survive the server's short feed window.

patches.name: Spoof Widevine / DRM level
patches.description:
Reports Widevine L1 (hardware DRM) to apps that check DRM level locally.

Useful for apps that refuse to play HD/4K content on L3 devices or after re-signing.

Does not bypass server-side DRM - Netflix, Disney+ and similar are not affected.

options.title: Widevine security level to report
options.description: L1 = hardware DRM (highest quality). L3 = software only. Default L1.

options.title: HDCP level to report
options.description: HDCP_V2_2 is required for 4K content on most streaming apps.

patches.name: Spoof app signature
patches.description:
Makes the app think its signing certificate is unchanged after Morphe re-signs it.

Useful when an app crashes or shows a tamper warning because it checks its own certificate.

Does not bypass Play Integrity / SafetyNet hardware attestation.

Apply with Original app certificate patch.

options.title: Package name override (optional)
options.description: Leave blank — read automatically from the app. Only set this if you changed the app's package name and the patch is using the wrong one.

patches.name: Spoof install source
patches.description:
Makes the app think it was installed from a specific store (default: Google Play).

Useful when an app blocks features or shows errors because it detects it was not installed from the Play Store.

Only affects what the app itself sees - does not change the real system install record.

options.title: Store to impersonate
options.description: Most apps only check for the Google Play Store, so the default is usually correct. Pick from the list, or type any package name directly if your app checks for a different store.

patches.name: Spoof stock signing cert hash
patches.description: Makes NativeUtils.setAppToken() return the stock app's certificate hash instead of the patched build's, so the server-side device/app integrity verdict ('App Error: NO IMSI') is not tripped by the re-signed APK.

patches.name: Unbloat (trim manifest)
patches.description: Removes the third-party launcher-badge permission zoo Teams declares (Samsung/HTC/Sony/Huawei/OPPO/badger), which only add manifest bulk.

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Unlocks Strava Premium features (spoofs PAID state + far-future expiry). Also re-enables password login after OTP.

patches.name: Unlock Pro
patches.description: Forces every "pro_unlock" entitlement check to true, unlocking the client-side Pro features without touching the signed purchase store.

options.title: Unlock Pro
options.description: Force all pro_unlock entitlement checks to true.

patches.name: Unlock Proton Plus features
patches.description: Makes the client treat the account as Proton Plus: unlocks the settings features, NetShield levels and the connection limit. Server-side plan enforcement (Plus-only servers) cannot be changed by a client patch.

options.title: Unlock Proton Plus features
options.description: Treat the account as Proton Plus in the client (features, NetShield levels and the device/connection limit).

patches.name: Unlock hidden feature flags
patches.description: Flips the server-sent feature flags showO2A/showO2AShop/showO2ABuy/showUber/showDeleteAccount to true in every API response before the JS sees it, revealing app screens the server hides.
